announcement_date_reconciliation: The original SEC issuer exhibit has a San Diego November 25 dateline. The full merger chronology says November 26 premarket publication. The issuer-distributed PRNewswire release expressly records November 26 at 01:10 ET (06:10 UTC), which is November 25 at 22:10 Pacific. Timezone reconciliation is an inference, not an independently proved earliest-public timestamp. The existing November 26 date-only event and conservative civil-time uncertainty bounds are retained; no exact first-public time is invented.
evidence_paraphrase: The Roche collaboration began in 2022. A different party made a private acquisition proposal in April 2023, then withdrew in June; Roche declined acquisition discussions at that time. The August 2023 Astellas financing conveyed observer, information and program rights rather than company control. Roche acquisition proposals and negotiations began in August 2024, followed by further bargaining and competing-party outreach. Final approval and execution occurred November 25, with the disclosed public announcement November 26. Thus January 1 preceded any executed or publicly definitive company-sale agreement in the complete disclosed chronology.
scope: Retrospective agent review of the entire designated original merger-background section including private/public sequencing. Not an exhaustive independent world-news audit, inventory of every later proxy amendment, legal opinion or pre-observation model feature.
